commentary: Margin step-up driven by sales growth, lower payroll costs, and lower depreciation after Amazon extended the estimated useful life of its servers in 2024, partly offset by infrastructure spend to support growth.
source: Q1 2024 10-Q MD&A (Operating Income); confirm wording in Q3 2024 10-Q MD&A

metric: OI $1,315M vs. ($419M) a year earlier, +407 bps YoY
commentary: International turned consistently profitable through 2024 as higher unit sales and advertising sales outgrew increases in shipping and fulfillment costs; TTM operating income went positive in Q2 2024.
Decline is driven by a $2.5B FTC legal settlement booked in North America plus a share of $1.8B in company-wide severance; excluding the FTC charge, segment OI was $7.3B (6.9% margin).
Sales grew 37%, the fastest in 18 quarters, and outpaced the growth in infrastructure spend to support it; AWS delivered 61% of company OI on 21% of sales.
